conclusions: The earlier failed burst lacks operation/sample/verification attribution; no retrospective root cause is supported.
Mutation primary calls are the only operations with >50 ms maxima in the passing run and are useful investigation candidates, not attribution for the failed run.
The 587592 us residual combines verification and untimed work across 44 bursts; it is not scheduler or disk latency.
Barriers before/after each timed burst and the 250 ms cooldown are outside the timed interval. Scheduling delays inside that interval remain possible.
No production/build change occurred between these runs. The diagnostic-only change is not evidence of a performance repair.
The synthetic 9517/burst-26 helper regression is not an observed failing sample.
Two separate campaigns do not establish a failure rate or repeated-run stability.
